about_the_game:
Trapped in a zero-gravity space station twisted by a corrupted AI, you must survive a labyrinth of shifting corridors and relentless obstacles. Scavenge for resources, upgrade your suit, and fight your way through terrifying threats.

FEATURES

  • Procedurally Generated Levels: Encounter a new layout every time you enter a level or restart after death.

  • Scavenge for Survival: Search for weapons, ammo, and resources to increase your chances of survival.

  • Inventory Management: Strategically manage your limited inventory to carry only what you need most.

  • Diverse Enemy Threats: Face a variety of relentless enemies hunting you throughout the station.

  • Customizable Suit Modules: Upgrade your suit with powerful modules to enhance your abilities and suit your playstyle.

  • Discover the Story: Find logs to unveil the station’s dark secrets and the experiment that shattered reality.

content_descriptors.notes: Frequent violence, along with pixelated blood and gore.
